name: RobotStateFlags
meaning: u16 flags word of g_robotStateTable entries (0x57a882 + 4*state)

name: ROBOT_SF_CARRIED
meaning: Robot_EnterState sets ScnObjFlags 0x400 NO_BOX_COLLIDE and shadow.flags bit 1 (state 2 only)

name: ROBOT_SF_ALWAYS_UPDATE
meaning: ScnObjFlags 0x4000 (updated beyond the camera radius); absent in states 0 and 2

name: ROBOT_SF_ACTIVE
meaning: driven branch of Robot_Update (ReadPad + state switch); msg 0x3680 returns it

name: ROBOT_SF_GROUNDED
meaning: passed as flag f1 to ScnControllable_ApplyMoveModifiers; set on ground states

name: ROBOT_SF_EJECTED
meaning: states 0x11-0x14: msg 0x3F on/off and the View release do not change state; msg 0x3682 is true
